newsitem.title: GREECE: ECU/DRS CREEPS LOWER, FORWARDS FLAT IN LATE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ECU/DRS CREEPS LOWER, FORWARDS FLAT IN LATE TRADE.

text.p: The drachma garnered new strength against the ecu trading around 303.08/13 in late trade and forex forwards were steady at lower levels since this morning, dealers said.

"Ecu/drachma has eased further in late dealing. About 140 million ecus were sold for drachmas at the fixing," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "Forex forwards have stabilised at lower levels but depos are holding."
Bonds and FRNs maintained their upward bias in late dealings, bond traders said.
The mark was quoted at 155.92/97 drachmas from Friday's 155.950 fix, the dollar at 245.88/98 drachmas from 245.940 and the Ecu at 303.08/13 from 303.160 drachmas.
